name: cache-meter
description: Prompt-cache hit rate in one row above the prompt, with how long the cache stays warm and a Keep warm switch that refreshes it while you are away.

display.title: Display
display.description: gauge shows a five-segment fill level before each percentage; text shows the percentage alone.

details.title: Details
details.description: Show the token counts, such as (92k/100k) in parentheses.

keepWarmMinutes.title: Keep warm for
keepWarmMinutes.description: How many minutes after the last turn Keep warm goes on refreshing the cache. Each refresh reads the cached context at the cache price.
